output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potentially drastic reduction in the token's value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value can overflow if _value is very large, causing a contract state inconsistency.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value can overflow if _value is very large, causing a contract state inconsistency.
